level.name: First Impression
level.subtitle: Bring the crate around to its mark.
level.hint: Walk around the crate before you push.

level.name: Corner Turn
level.subtitle: A straight push is only the beginning.
level.hint: Push left first, then get underneath.

level.name: Ink Post
level.subtitle: One obstacle changes the route.
level.hint: Use the open side to get behind the crate twice.

level.name: Offset Pair
level.subtitle: Two crates, crossed destinations.
level.hint: Move the right crate out of the lower lane first.
